_comment: Tony's Tech Support shop settings. Prices are AUD. Edit this file to change markup, services and payment details, then the next nightly build picks it up.

pricing._capAtRRP: If true, a product is never priced above the supplier's recommended retail price (RRP).
pricing._freightExGst: Estimated freight from the distributor to you, per item, before GST. It is added to cost before the markup. Adjust to match your real freight charges.
pricing._perthPreferencePct: When both distributors stock an item, stock held in Perth wins unless the other is more than this % cheaper.
pricing._roundTo: All product prices and calculated charges are rounded up to the nearest $5.
pricing._hideWithoutPhoto: true hides products that have no photo yet. Add your own photos to the photos/ folder named after the part number, e.g. photos/B9GD4PT.jpg.

leadTimes._comment: Supplier days to reach Tony, before the extra handling days are added. Shown to clients as a range in calendar days.

services._setupBase: Hand delivery and setup = setupBase + callout fee, includes 1 hour of setup and walkthrough.
services._courierFactor: Standard Uber Courier delivery = callout fee x this factor.

addons.name: Emsisoft Anti-Malware, 1-year licence, installed and set up
Microsoft Office Home 2024, installed (one-off purchase, no subscription)
Private local AI assistant, installed and tuned for this device (no subscription)

freeApps.name: Ad blocker for your web browser
RustDesk remote support (so Tony can help you remotely)
Make Windows 11 look and feel like Windows 10

callout._comment: Callout fee = straight-line distance from Hazelmere x roadFactor x 2 (round trip) x ratePerKm, rounded up to roundTo, minimum minFee, free within freeDistanceKm round trip. Distances come from site_src/suburbs.json (WA suburbs).
callout._maxOneWayKm: Suburbs further than this (straight line) show 'Tony will confirm the cost'.

payments._comment: Shown at checkout and on the order confirmation page. Bank details only appear after an order is placed. Leave a value blank to hide that option.
payments.nameNote: Your bank may display my name as Anthony Gerald Shannon or A.G.S.
payments._stripeWorker: Optional: URL of your Cloudflare Worker for instant card payments (see stripe-worker/README.md).

orders._webhookUrl: Paste your Tech Automation (GoHighLevel) Inbound Webhook URL here. Each order is sent there so the workflow can text you.
